_about: Skills (D113), learnt by doing, Project Zomboid style and our own numbers. Each skill: name, what raises it, what a level does (per_level: the fraction per level; the code knows which effect), and the XP that reaches each level (levels: cumulative, level 1 at the first number). Kept per world in user://skills.json; dying doesn't take them (like recipe books, D112).

first_aid.name: First aid
first_aid.effect: bandages heal {p} more, medical crafts {p} faster

woodcraft.name: Woodcraft
woodcraft.effect: chopping {p} faster; from level 3 a tree gives an armful more
